name: testimonials-by-role
title: Testimonials by role
description: Let visitors hear from people like them: role or industry chips narrow a grid of quotes, and the count is announced.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, testimonials ({ id, quote, name, role, group, avatar? }) and groups (the chip labels after All; each quote's group must equal one of them). The chips are one toggle group with exactly one pressed, so the arrow keys move between them and pressing the pressed chip keeps it; the count under them ('4 of 12 quotes', labels.count) is a polite live region. Quotes sit in balanced columns at their natural height, with as many columns as the filter leaves quotes for (one quote is centred at a readable width, two or four fill two columns, three or more fill three from 1024px), so a short result never hugs one side; they swap with a crossfade while the section glides to its new height, so nothing jumps; reduced motion swaps at once. A group with no quotes shows one line and a button back to All, and focus moves to the first chip when it is used. Uncontrolled with defaultGroup, or controlled with group (null is All) and onGroupChange.
